decision_cruda.rationale: N600-08 stopped 5-8h, so LH-05 is idle. Activate RS-N522-03 (Norte, 412 t at 9.5 gpt) with LH-05. Travel is 0.37h and activation 0.5h. The loader then runs about 4.5h at 38.5 t/h, which is about 175 t or about 53 oz. Norte stockpile is empty and the trucks (66 t/h) are not a limit. RS-E543-02 has slightly higher grade, but Este is already truck-limited and travel is longer. No loans, so no development or producing place loses a loader.
